# Mortgage — Ferrington

Taken on purchase in March 2024 on a five-year fix. The filename carries an em
dash, which any link to this note has to percent-encode, and that is the reason
this note exists in the fixture.

## Terms

- Account number: FB-40028871
- Advance: 322,000 over 28 years
- Fixed at 4.19% until 31 March 2029
- Early repayment charge: 3% until March 2027, then 2%
- Monthly payment: 1,742.08 on the 1st

## Remortgage

The fix ends in 2029 but the remortgage work started early in 2026 to understand
the fees. A conveyancer was instructed and then stood down when the product fee
made the switch uneconomic before the ERC drops.
